paragraphs: This is GitHub Trending Today number 14, and I've handpicked 27 trending open-source projects that are blowing up right now. Let's get started.

Tock is a command-line time-tracking tool built for developers who live in the terminal. It logs your work in simple, human-readable plain text files so your data stays portable and future-proof. You also get a beautiful interactive TUI complete with a calendar view, powered by Bubble Tea, built in Go with clean architecture. It's fast and ships as a single binary with zero dependencies.

CLAWDIS is a WhatsApp and Telegram gateway for AI agents, letting you trigger actions on your own machine just by sending a message. It bridges WhatsApp Web and Telegram bots to a local coding agent, making it perfect for setups like Claude Code running from your pocket. You get group chat support, media handling, and even a dedicated browser profile for screenshots and automation.

What if you could talk to every top AI model at the same time on your Mac? This is Chorus, an open-source desktop app that lets you chat with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and local models side by side in one place. No more guessing which model is right. Chorus shows you all their answers at once. Chorus can see what's on your screen so the models understand what you're working on. No explaining, no context switching.

This project brings the Windows 11 clipboard history experience straight to Linux, and it's surprisingly polished. It works on both Wayland and X11 using low-level input handling to bypass the usual Wayland limitations. Hit Super+V and your clipboard pops up instantly right where your mouse is, even across multiple monitors. You get pinning, rich media support, and a built-in emoji picker. Perfect for chat apps and dev workflows.

macUSB makes creating bootable macOS and OS X USB installers ridiculously easy, especially on Apple Silicon Macs. If you've ever hit terminal errors, expired certificates, or broken installers while trying to revive an older Intel Mac, this tool fixes that. It's a one-click app that detects the macOS version, formats the USB drive, and builds the installer automatically. If you support legacy Macs, this is a lifesaver.

Stop doom-scrolling through 100-page SEC filings. This is tenk. Talk to 10-Ks and 10-Qs with AI. Instead of reading filings line by line, you just ask questions in plain English, and tenk answers with real citations linked straight to the source. No hallucinations, no guessing. It auto-fetches filings from the SEC, indexes them locally with RAG, and lets you query across multiple reports instantly.

Proxy Checker Pro is a professional-grade proxy testing tool with a clean GUI. It supports HTTP and SOCKS5 proxies, including full username and password authentication. You can load proxies in almost any format, test them in real time, and even measure actual download speed. It automatically detects proxy location and lets you verify proxies using HTTP requests or raw socket checks.

Stepifi is a self-hosted STL-to-STEP converter built for makers and 3D printing enthusiasts. If you've ever downloaded an STL and struggled to edit it in Fusion 360 or FreeCAD, this solves that problem. You get a drag-and-drop web interface with a real-time 3D preview so you can inspect meshes before converting. Stepifi automatically repairs broken meshes and lets you tune conversion tolerance.

toMCP lets you turn any website or documentation into an MCP server instantly. Just add tomcp.org before any URL and your docs become structured, AI-ready context. Instead of dumping noisy HTML into prompts, toMCP cleans pages into readable markdown using far fewer tokens. The real win: persistent MCP resources. Documentation stays pinned as trusted, read-only context, dramatically reducing hallucinations.

llmwalk lets you explore the full answer space of a prompt. It branches across the most likely tokens, then ranks complete answers by probability. The tree is walked intelligently, stopping as soon as it's guaranteed to have the top-N most likely outputs. It works with MLX-supported open models, runs straight from the CLI, and gives you deep insight into what an LLM almost said but didn't.

PageFlow is a minimal macOS PDF viewer built for speed. It's written in SwiftUI with PDFKit, so everything feels fast and perfectly Mac-native. You get annotations, bookmarks, and powerful text search without clutter or bloat. Switch between single-page or two-up views, depending on how you read. It updates automatically, works fully offline, and collects zero telemetry.

Ein UI is a liquid glass component library you can preview, copy, and drop straight into your web apps. It delivers a polished frosted-glass aesthetic, fully accessible and responsive out of the box. Components are distributed via the shadcn/ui registry, so installing them into existing projects is effortless. There's a full documentation and preview site, plus ready-made page templates like admin dashboards.

Need to remove image backgrounds instantly without uploading your photos anywhere? Meet CutItOut, an open-source AI background remover that runs entirely in your browser. CutItOut uses the powerful U²-Net deep learning model running via WebAssembly and ONNX, so your images never leave your device. And it's not just one-click magic. You get pro-level editing tools, plus zoom and pan for pixel-perfect control. Export full-resolution transparent PNGs.

Gemini Desktop for macOS is a lightweight unofficial desktop wrapper for Google Gemini. It gives you a native macOS experience while simply loading the official Gemini web interface. Nothing scraped, nothing modified. The standout feature is a floating chat bar that stays on top of your apps. With a global keyboard shortcut you can trigger it from anywhere.

sqlit is like lazygit but for SQL databases: a lightweight terminal UI that gets you querying PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, and more in seconds. It comes with a connection manager so you can save connections and switch databases without juggling CLI arguments. Out of the box, it supports multiple databases, has built-in SSH tunnels, Vim-style modal editing, and query history per connection.

Shout is a lightweight speech-to-text tool for Wayland and Hyprland. Hit a key to start recording, hit it again to transcribe, and press Enter. It's that simple. It's designed to be fast and unobtrusive, perfect for quickly turning speech into text without leaving your workflow. Works especially well with AI coding agents like Claude Code where transcription doesn't have to be perfect to be useful.

DimanDocs is a lightweight web-based Markdown documentation browser that keeps your files organized and easy to navigate. It scans multiple directories, automatically extracts overviews from overview sections, and presents everything in a clean, responsive web interface. Deployment is a breeze: a single binary with embedded templates and a simple config file.

Markdown Site is a Markdown-powered website built with React, perfect for blogs. Write posts in Markdown, run a single sync command, and your content appears live instantly with real-time updates across all browsers thanks to Convex. It supports syntax-highlighted code blocks, four themes, responsive design, and real-time analytics.

Universal Reddit Scraper Suite is a full-featured Reddit scraping and analytics platform that doesn't require any API keys. Scrape posts, comments, images, videos, and galleries, and visualize everything on a beautiful Streamlit dashboard with multiple tabs. Keep track of job history, durations, and errors. Run dry tests, export data to Parquet, and schedule scrapes with cron-style jobs.

pdf-sign is a lightweight PDF signing tool written in Rust that supports OpenPGP and Sigstore signatures. It appends cryptographic signatures directly to PDFs, keeping your documents authentic, tamper-proof, and fully compatible with standard PDF readers. For casual users, you can sign PDFs with your Google, Microsoft, or GitHub account — no keys to manage.

See&Trek is a training-free, GPU-free spatial prompting framework for MLLMs. It enhances spatial reasoning by combining semantic-rich keyframe extraction with camera trajectory reconstruction via visual odometry, giving your models explicit motion cues. No fine-tuning or architecture changes are needed. A single forward pass injects structured spatiotemporal priors directly into the model.

CSVX Editor is a web-based spreadsheet tool built for the CSVX format, an enhanced CSV that adds rich formatting metadata while staying compatible with standard CSV readers. It gives you full control over cell formatting, colors, gradients, text styles, alignment, wrapping, and borders, all visually previewed in the editor. Edit single or multiple cells at once and handle large data sets efficiently with lazy loading.

Mention Network Bot is a multi-threaded automation tool for Mention Network powered by AI models like Google Gemini. It generates organic, context-aware conversations, manages daily quests, and optimizes point-farming efficiency across multiple accounts. The bot features a smart persona system to create unique AI personalities and multi-threaded operation for simultaneous accounts.

PDF Brain is a local PDF knowledge base with semantic vector search, letting you extract, embed, and search your documents intelligently. It's local-first, so everything runs on your machine with no API costs. Search your PDFs using vector embeddings via mxbai-embed-large, or combine it with full-text search for a hybrid approach.

Life Tracker Plugin transforms Obsidian into a personal data visualization hub, letting you capture and visualize the data that matters most in your life. It offers 12 chart types — from heat maps and line charts to polar radar and even tag clouds. All interactive and animated. Charts support GitHub-style heat maps, tooltips, clickable elements that open source notes, and configurable color schemes.

SPIDER is a physics-based retargeting framework that maps human motions to a wide range of robotic embodiments — from dexterous hands to full humanoids. It's the first general-purpose pipeline supporting multiple robots and data sets out of the box, with seamless integration into reinforcement learning and behavior cloning workflows. SPIDER works natively with multiple simulators like MuJoCo, RAP, and Genesis.

MetalGoose is a GPU-accelerated upscaling and frame generation tool for macOS. It delivers smooth high-FPS performance for games and apps, similar to NVIDIA DLSS or AMD FSR but optimized for macOS with MetalFX upscaling. Choose from performance, balanced, or quality modes and multiple render scales enhanced by contrast-adaptive sharpening.
